subject_line: An Author Spotlight for The Need for Dandelions
email_body:
Hi Alex,

Congratulations on The Need for Dandelions, your Achillean romantasy released independently in 2026. A fantasy love story between two men is exactly the kind of book queer readers go looking for, and it deserves a wider audience.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author.

Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

If a short trailer or a few promotional reels for The Need for Dandelions is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production. It is entirely optional and separate from the Spotlight.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit The Need for Dandelions best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
The Author Ledger
